name: What are the first steps to plan a basement renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are the first steps to plan a basement renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting a basement renovation typically involves defining your project goals, such as adding a new living space, bedroom, or home office. Next, research local building codes and permits, especially concerning egress windows, ceiling height, and electrical work. We recommend consulting with a general contractor early to discuss design options, budget, and feasibility. They can help you understand the structural requirements, waterproofing needs, and overall timeline. A clear plan ensures a smooth process and a functional, code-compliant space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin by defining your project goals and researching local building codes. Consult a contractor to discuss design, budget, and feasibility.
